There are no `eval`, `bash`, `curl`, `wget`, or other potentially dangerous commands anywhere in the file. The file is a standard AUR PKGBUILD for libopenshot with no signs of supply-chain compromise or malicious intent.

Since `--printsrcinfo` only parses and displays the PKGBUILD metadata without downloading or executing any external code, it poses no security risk.
</details>
